data.title: Tamarac Rehabilitation & Health Center Named to Newsweek's 2027 List of America's Best Nursing Homes
data.description: In the recent ranking by Newsweek for America's Best Nursing Homes in 2027, Tamarac Rehabilitation & Health Center in Tamarac, Florida, managed by Sabal Health, secured the 20th position in the category that includes facilities with beds ranging from 100 to 149. This recognition showcases the high standard of care provided by the center. Newsweek's recognition further solidifies the reputation of Tamarac Rehabilitation & Health Center as one of the top healthcare facilities in the area. The facility's dedication to excellence in patient care and overall operations contributed to this prestigious ranking.
